info.title: OpenMetadata APIs
info.description: Common types and API definition for OpenMetadata

tags.name: ChangeSummary
tags.description: APIs to retrieve change summary metadata for entities. Change summary tracks who changed each field, the source of the change (e.g., Suggested for AI-generated, Manual for user edits), and when the change occurred.

tags.name: Activity Stream
tags.description: Lightweight activity notifications for dashboards and feeds.

tags.name: AI Applications
tags.description: `AI Applications` are autonomous software entities that use LLM models to perform tasks, make decisions, and interact with data sources.

tags.name: AI Context
tags.description: Question-anchored AI context discovery: semantically search the company-knowledge layer (glossary terms, metrics, articles) and route each hit to the candidate data assets it points to. Asset-anchored context is served per entity at /v1/{entities}/name/{fqn}/context.

tags.name: AI Framework Controls
tags.description: Controls within an AI Governance Framework (e.g. EU AI Act Article 10).

tags.name: AI Governance Frameworks
tags.description: Workspace-level AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, custom). Enabled frameworks drive per-asset compliance assessments.

tags.name: AI Governance Policies
tags.description: `AI Governance Policies` define rules, compliance requirements, bias thresholds, and control measures for AI agents and models.

tags.name: AI Governance
tags.description: Cross-asset AI governance endpoints: intake checks, submitForReview, approve, reject, shadow triage.

tags.name: Agent Executions
tags.description: `Agent Executions` are time-series records of AI agent execution runs, capturing observability metrics, governance checks, and performance data.

tags.name: AI Audit Reports
tags.description: Auto-generated audit packs (JSON/PDF evidence bundles) for AI governance. Submitted asynchronously and consumed by auditors and regulators.

tags.name: LLM Models
tags.description: `LLM Models` are Large Language Model instances such as GPT-4, Claude, Llama, or custom-trained models used for AI applications.

tags.name: MCP Executions
tags.description: `MCP Executions` are time-series records of MCP server execution sessions, capturing tool calls, resource accesses, data lineage, compliance checks, and audit trails for AI governance.

tags.name: MCP Servers
tags.description: `MCP Servers` are Model Context Protocol servers that expose tools, resources, and prompts for AI applications. They enable AI governance including risk assessment, compliance tracking, and shadow AI detection.

tags.name: Prompt Templates
tags.description: `Prompt Templates` are reusable, parameterized templates for LLM interactions that ensure consistent and effective prompting across AI agents.

tags.name: API Collections
tags.description: A `API Collection` is an optional way of grouping API Endpoints that belong to a API Service.

tags.name: API Endpoint
tags.description: A `API Endpoint` is a specific endpoint of an API that is part of an API Collection..

tags.name: Apps
tags.description: Apps marketplace holds to application available for Open-metadata

tags.name: Attachments
tags.description: APIs related to uploading attachments.

tags.name: Audit Logs
tags.description: APIs for listing user initiated change events persisted for auditing

tags.name: Bots
tags.description: A `Bot` automates tasks, such as ingesting metadata, and running data quality It performs this task as a special user in the system.

tags.name: Charts
tags.description: A `Chart` are computed from data presents data visually and can be part of `Dashboards`.

tags.name: Columns
tags.description: Columns represent individual data fields within tables and dashboard data models. This API provides operations to update column metadata such as tags, glossary terms, descriptions, and other properties using the column's fully qualified name.

tags.name: Context Memories
tags.description: APIs for managing reusable Context Center memories.

tags.name: CSV Async Jobs
tags.description: CSV import and export job status APIs.

tags.name: CSV
tags.description: CSV import and export metadata APIs.

tags.name: Dashboards
tags.description: Dashboards are computed from data and visually present data, metrics, and KPIs. They are typically updated in real-time and allow interactive data exploration.

tags.name: Data Contracts
tags.description: `DataContract` defines the schema and quality guarantees for a data asset.

tags.name: Databases
tags.description: A `Database` also referred to as `Database Catalog` is a collection of schemas.

tags.name: Database Schemas
tags.description: A `Database Schema` is collection of tables, views, stored procedures, and other database objects.

tags.name: Stored Procedures
tags.description: A `StoredProcedure` entity that contains the set of code statements with an assigned name .

tags.name: Tables
tags.description: `Table` organizes data in rows and columns and is defined in a `Database Schema`.

tags.name: Dashboard Data Models
tags.description: `Data Models` are the schemas used to build dashboards, charts, or other data assets.

tags.name: Document Store
tags.description: A `Document` is an generic entity in OpenMetadata.

tags.name: Domains
tags.description: A `Data Product` or `Data as a Product` is a logical unit that contains all components to process and store domain data for analytical or data-intensive use cases made available to data consumers.

tags.name: Data Quality
tags.description: APIs to retrieve dimensional test case results data.

tags.name: Test Case Incident Manager
tags.description: APIs to test case incident status from incident manager.

tags.name: Test Cases
tags.description: Test case is a test definition to capture data quality tests against tables, columns, and other data assets.

tags.name: Test Case Results
tags.description: Test case results are the results of running a test case on a dataset. This resource provides APIs to manage test case results.

tags.name: Test Definitions
tags.description: `Test Definition` is a definition of a type of test using which test cases are created that run against data to capture data quality.

tags.name: Test Suites
tags.description: `TestSuite` is a set of test cases grouped together to capture data quality.

tags.name: Context Center Drive Files
tags.description: APIs for managing files in the Context Center Drive.

tags.name: Context Center Drive Folders
tags.description: APIs for managing folders in the Context Center Drive.

tags.name: Directories
tags.description: A `Directory` is a folder or organizational unit in a Drive Service that can contain files, spreadsheets, and other directories.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: A `File` is a document or resource stored in a Drive Service.

tags.name: Spreadsheets
tags.description: A `Spreadsheet` is a file format for organizing data in a tabular format, like Google Sheets or Excel files.

tags.name: Worksheets
tags.description: A `Worksheet` is an individual sheet or tab within a Spreadsheet.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: The `Events` are changes to metadata and are sent when entities are created, modified, or updated. External systems can subscribe to events using event subscription API over Webhooks, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.

tags.name: Notification Templates
tags.description: Notification templates for customizing event notifications

tags.name: Announcements
tags.description: Time-bound notifications for data assets

tags.name: Feeds
tags.description: Feeds API supports `Activity Feeds` and `Conversation Threads`.

tags.name: Task Form Schemas
tags.description: Form schemas for task types

tags.name: Glossaries
tags.description: A `Glossary` is collection of hierarchical `GlossaryTerms`.

tags.name: IntakeForms
tags.description: An IntakeForm declares fields shown for a governance entity and which are required. Required fields are enforced at the API layer, layered on top of the entity's schema-required fields.

tags.name: Workflow Definitions
tags.description: A `Workflow Definition` is a configured workflow setup for a given governance task.

tags.name: Workflow Instances
tags.description: A Workflow Instance is a specific instance of a Workflow Definition.

tags.name: Workflow Instance States
tags.description: A Workflow Instance State is a specific state of a Workflow Instance.

tags.name: Context Center Pages
tags.description: APIs related to Context Center pages (articles and quick links).

tags.name: Learning Resources
tags.description: Inline tutorials and expert content surfaced across OpenMetadata product surfaces.

tags.name: Lineage
tags.description: The `Lineage` for a given data asset, has information of the input datasets used and the ETL pipeline that created it.

tags.name: OpenLineage
tags.description: OpenLineage API for receiving lineage events from external systems like Spark, Airflow, etc.

tags.name: MCP Usage
tags.description: MCP tool-call usage counters and breakdowns.

tags.name: Metrics
tags.description: `Metrics` are measurements computed from data such as `Monthly Active Users`. Some of the metrics that measures used to determine performance against an objective are called KPIs or Key Performance Indicators, such as `User Retention`.

tags.name: ML Models
tags.description: `Machine Learning Models` are algorithms trained on data to find patterns or make predictions.

tags.name: Permissions
tags.description: APIs related to getting access permission for a User.

tags.name: Pipelines
tags.description: A `Pipeline` enables the flow of data from source to destination through a series of processing steps. ETL is a type of pipeline where the series of steps Extract, Transform and Load the data.

tags.name: Policies
tags.description: A `Policy` defines control that needs to be applied across different Data Entities.

tags.name: Query Cost Record Manager
tags.description: APIs to query cost records from usage workflow.

tags.name: Queries
tags.description: A `Query` entity represents a SQL query associated with data assets it is run against.

tags.name: RDF
tags.description: APIs for RDF and SPARQL operations

tags.name: RDF SQL
tags.description: Execute SQL queries over RDF data

tags.name: Reports (beta)
tags.description: `Reports` are static information computed from data periodically that includes data in text, table, and visual form.

tags.name: SCIM
tags.description: SCIM 2.0 compliant user and group provisioning endpoints.

tags.name: Search Reindex
tags.description: APIs related to search reindexing failures and status.

tags.name: Search
tags.description: APIs related to search and suggest.

tags.name: Vector Search
tags.description: APIs for vector-based semantic search.

tags.name: SearchIndex
tags.description: A `SearchIndex` is a index mapping for indexing documents in a `Search Service`.

tags.name: Services
tags.description: Cross-service-type APIs spanning every kind of service in one request.

tags.name: API Services
tags.description: APIs related `API Service` entities, such as REST or MicroService.

tags.name: Database Services
tags.description: `Database Service` is a service such as MySQL, BigQuery, Redshift, Postgres, or Snowflake. Alternative terms such as Database Cluster, Database Server instance are also used for database service.

tags.name: Drive Services
tags.description: `Drive Service` is a cloud file storage service such as Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, Box, or Dropbox where documents, spreadsheets, and other files are stored.

tags.name: Ingestion Pipelines
tags.description: APIs related pipelines/workflows created by the system to ingest metadata.

tags.name: LLM Services
tags.description: `LLM Service` is a service for Large Language Model providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or custom LLM deployments.

tags.name: MCP Services
tags.description: `MCP Service` is a service for discovering and managing MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, their tools, resources, and prompts for AI governance.

tags.name: Metadata Services
tags.description: APIs related to creating and managing other Metadata Services that OpenMetadata integrates with such as `Apache Atlas`, `Amundsen`, etc.

tags.name: Search Services
tags.description: APIs related `Search Service` entities, such as ElasticSearch, OpenSearch.

tags.name: Security Services
tags.description: APIs related to Security Service entities, such as Apache Ranger.

tags.name: Object Store Services
tags.description: APIs related `Object Store Service` entities, such as S3, GCS or AZURE.

tags.name: Containers
tags.description: A Container is an abstraction for any path(including the top level eg. bucket in S3) storing data in an Object store such as S3, GCP, Azure. It maps a tree-like structure, where each Container can have a parent and a list of sub-folders, and it can be structured - where it contains structured data, or unstructured where no schema for its data is defined.

tags.name: System
tags.description: System diagnostics providing a performance snapshot for load test correlation

tags.name: Classifications
tags.description: These APIs are related to `Classification` and `Tags`. A `Classification` entity contains hierarchical terms called `Tags` used for categorizing and classifying data assets and other entities.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: Tasks for data governance workflows

tags.name: Personas
tags.description: A `Persona` is to represent job function a user does.  OpenMetadata uses Persona to define customizable experience in the UI.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: A `Role` is a collection of `Policies` that provides access control. A user or a team can be assigned one or multiple roles that provide privileges to a user and members of a team to perform the job function.

tags.name: Teams
tags.description: A `Team` is a group of zero or more users and/or other teams. Teams can own zero or more data assets. Hierarchical teams are supported `Organization` -> `BusinessUnit` -> `Division` -> `Department`.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: A `User` represents a user of OpenMetadata. A user can be part of 0 or more teams. A special type of user called Bot is used for automation. A user can be an owner of zero or more data assets. A user can also follow zero or more data assets.

tags.name: TestSupport
tags.description: Admin-only read-only search introspection for tests

tags.name: Topics
tags.description: A `Topic` is a feed or an event stream in a `Messaging Service` into which publishers publish messages and consumed by consumers.

tags.name: Metadata
tags.description: These APIs are for managing custom property definitions in OpenMetadata. Use these APIs to create custom properties with predefined data types (String, Integer, Date, etc.) that extend entity metadata. Note: This does not support creating new custom data types - only custom properties using existing OpenMetadata data types.

tags.name: Usage
tags.description: APIs related usage of data assets.

get.summary: Get change summary for an entity by fully qualified name
get.description: Returns the change summary map for the specified entity identified by its fully qualified name (FQN). Use fieldPrefix to filter entries (e.g., 'columns.' for column-level changes only).

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Entity type (e.g., table, topic, dashboard)

parameters.name: fqn
parameters.description: Fully qualified name of the entity

parameters.name: fieldPrefix
parameters.description: Filter entries by field name prefix (e.g., 'columns.' to get only column-level changes)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit the number of entries returned (1-1000)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset for pagination

404.description: Entity not found

get.summary: Get change summary for an entity by ID
get.description: Returns the change summary map for the specified entity, showing who changed each field, the source of the change (Manual, Suggested, Automated, etc.), and when it was changed. Use fieldPrefix to filter entries (e.g., 'columns.' for column-level changes only).

parameters.name: fieldPrefix
parameters.description: Filter entries by field name prefix (e.g., 'columns.' to get only column-level changes)

post.summary: Batch-resolve the knowledge attached to a set of assets
post.description: For each asset (fqn + entityType), returns the knowledge linked to it: glossary terms from asset and column tags, metrics applied to it, and articles about it. Deliberately lightweight (no profile, lineage, or budgeting; item content capped) so search layers can annotate a whole result page in one call. Assets the caller cannot view are skipped.

requestBody.description: Assets to resolve, as {fullyQualifiedName, entityType} pairs

get.summary: Find company knowledge relevant to a question, routed to candidate assets
get.description: REST surface of the find_context MCP tool. Runs a semantic search over the knowledge layer (glossary terms, metrics, articles) and returns the matching definitions together with the candidate data assets each item routes to (glossary terms via tag usage, metrics via APPLIED_TO, articles via HAS). Candidate assets are filtered to those the caller can view.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Natural-language question to find knowledge for

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Maximum knowledge items to return

200.description: Knowledge items and the candidate assets they route to

get.summary: Get Data Quality Report
get.description:
Use the search service to perform data quality aggregation. You can use the `q` parameter to filter the results.
the `aggregationQuery` is of the form `bucketName=<bucketName>:aggType=<aggType>:field=<field>`. You can sperate aggregation
query with a comma `,` to perform nested aggregations.
For example, `bucketName=table:aggType=terms:field=databaseName,bucketName=<bucketName>:aggType=<aggType>:field=<field>`

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query to filter the aggregation results

parameters.name: aggregationQuery
parameters.description: Aggregation query to perform aggregation on the search results

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index to perform the aggregation against

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Filter by domain fully qualified name

post.summary: Run a batch of Data Quality Reports
post.description:
Run multiple data quality report aggregations in a single request. Each item is executed
concurrently on the server and the results are returned keyed by the request `key`. Use
this to avoid N+1 round trips when a dashboard needs many aggregations at once. A failure
in one item does not fail the batch; that item's result carries an `error` instead of a `report`.

Filter semantics: `q` narrows the count maps as well as the list. The three selectors (`listEntityType`, `serviceType`, `health`) narrow only `data` and `paging.total`, so a client can use each count map as the option list for its own filter control without that control eating its own menu.

`offset` + `limit` must not exceed 10000; use the per-service-type list APIs with cursor paging for deeper traversal.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Service entity types forming the universe for the count maps. Repeatable. Defaults to all.

parameters.name: listEntityType
parameters.description: Restrict `data` to these service entity types. Repeatable. Defaults to the universe.

parameters.name: serviceType
parameters.description: Connector type, e.g. `Snowflake`. Repeatable. Affects `data` only.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: Health state. Repeatable. Affects `data` only. Implies `includeHealth`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on name and displayName.

parameters.name: includeHealth
parameters.description: Compute per-service health. Costs three extra batched queries.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Sort direction on name.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Fully qualified name of a domain to restrict results to.

parameters.name: excludeProvider
parameters.description: Exclude services with this provider, e.g. `system`.

200.description: Service counts and one page of services

get.summary: Stream logs for a pipeline run
get.description: Tail a pipeline run's logs over Server-Sent Events so a client renders them as they are produced instead of polling. Reads from whichever backend holds the run's log — object storage when streamable logs are enabled for the pipeline, the pipeline service otherwise. Every event carries an `after` cursor; reconnect with `?after=<cursor>` to resume without re-reading what was already delivered. The server closes the stream with a `complete` event once the run finishes, and all viewers of the same run share a single reader against the log backend.

parameters.name: fqn
parameters.description: Id (UUID) or fullyQualifiedName of the ingestion pipeline

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: Run to stream. A UUID for a run whose logs are in object storage, or the pipeline service's own run identifier.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Resume the stream after this cursor, as returned by a previous event

200.description: Log stream of `logs`, `complete` and `error` events. A deployment with no log backend, or a server at its stream capacity, answers on the stream itself with a single `error` event.

delete.summary: Delete stale topics within a scope
delete.description: Delete entities within the given scope (service, database, or databaseSchema) that the ingestion connector did not report in the current run. The connector sends the set of FQNs it saw; entities in scope not in that set are considered stale. By default the deletion is soft; pass hardDelete=true to hard-delete instead. Returns a BulkOperationResult of deleted (or, for dryRun, would-be-deleted) entities.

requestBody.description: Scope to reconcile and the FQNs the connector saw this run. Carried as a request body on DELETE; a topology that strips it is rejected with 400 rather than being read as an empty seen-set.
